result.Method of Attack: Exploits Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) vulnerability via obfuscated LDAP requests to execute remote code; downloads and executes malicious scripts to deploy XMRig cryptocurrency miner; establishes persistence via systemd services or cron jobs depending on user privileges; performs system reconnaissance and exfiltrates data via HTTP POST; sets up multiple reverse shells and encrypted communication channels for backdoor access; removes traces by clearing bash history and self-deleting
result.Impacted Systems: Java applications using vulnerable Apache Log4j library; systems running Linux with systemd or cron; systems susceptible to remote code execution via Log4Shell
result.Attack Vector: Remote code execution via Log4Shell vulnerability in Java applications; obfuscated LDAP JNDI lookup to load malicious Java class; downloading and executing payloads via curl or wget; persistence via systemd service or cron jobs; reverse shell backdoors over TCP ports with encrypted communication
